title: Meetings & Events Package Rate Sheet: Price per Person and Inclusions
content:
Every Meetings & Events contract at an Ashbury hotel is sold under one of six packages. The package price is charged per billed attendee and is stated before service charge and sales tax; the hours shown are hours of function space use, and set-up and tear-down hours are included in addition to them.

## Price and time

| Package | Package price per billed attendee (USD) | Function space use included (hours) | Set-up and tear-down included outside the package hours (hours) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Executive Boardroom Package | 95.00 | 8 | 1 |
| Half-Day Meeting Package | 79.00 | 4 | 1 |
| Full-Day Meeting Package | 129.00 | 8 | 1 |
| Social Reception Package | 85.00 | 3 | 2 |
| Wedding Celebration Package | 165.00 | 5 | 3 |
| Conference Plenary Package | 149.00 | 9 | 4 |

## Food and beverage included

| Package | Coffee breaks per attendee | Plated or buffet lunch | Plated or buffet dinner | Hosted bar included (hours) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Executive Boardroom Package | 2 | Included | Not included | 0 |
| Half-Day Meeting Package | 1 | Not included | Not included | 0 |
| Full-Day Meeting Package | 2 | Included | Not included | 0 |
| Social Reception Package | 0 | Not included | Not included | 2 |
| Wedding Celebration Package | 0 | Not included | Included | 4 |
| Conference Plenary Package | 2 | Included | Not included | 0 |

## Equipment, room features and tasting

| Package | Standard audio-visual package | Meeting-room Wi-Fi | Dance floor | Persons invited to a complimentary menu tasting |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Executive Boardroom Package | Included | Included | Not included | 0 |
| Half-Day Meeting Package | Not included | Included | Not included | 0 |
| Full-Day Meeting Package | Included | Included | Not included | 0 |
| Social Reception Package | Not included | Included | Not included | 0 |
| Wedding Celebration Package | Not included | Included | Included | 2 |
| Conference Plenary Package | Not included | Included | Not included | 0 |

## Reading the sheet

- Meeting-room Wi-Fi is included in all six Meetings & Events packages.
- The standard audio-visual package is included only in the Executive Boardroom Package and the Full-Day Meeting Package.
- A lunch is included in the Executive Boardroom, Full-Day Meeting and Conference Plenary packages; a dinner only in the Wedding Celebration Package.
- Only the Wedding Celebration Package includes a dance floor and a complimentary menu tasting, for 2 persons.
- A package showing 0 hosted bar hours includes no hosted bar time; the Social Reception Package includes 2 hours and the Wedding Celebration Package 4.

**Hypothetical illustration.** A Full-Day Meeting Package contract with 30 billed attendees carries a package charge of 30 billed attendees multiplied by 129.00, that is 3,870.00, before service charge and sales tax, and includes 8 hours of function space use plus 1 hour of set-up and tear-down, two coffee breaks per attendee, a lunch, the standard audio-visual package and Wi-Fi.
